name: LORATADINE 2.5 MG / PHENYLEPHHRINE 5 MG / PARACETAMOL 500 MG 12 TABLETS
description: Over-the-counter flu reliever in tablet form, containing loratadine, phenylephrine, and paracetamol, provides continuous relief for 12 hours from flu symptoms such as fever, headache, nasal congestion, sneezing, and watery eyes. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
